note: Lean centres at the real c = ⌊y⌋+(q+1)/2, not at m_0 = ⌊y⌋+⌊(q+1)/2⌋, with the closed window |n-c| ≤ q/2 in place of j ∈ (-q/2,q/2]; the same residue-window set-up up to these conventions. Relation set in the session lead's sample check (was relatedMatch).

snippet.text:
set N := ⌊y⌋
  have hfl : ⌊y + q⌋ = N + q := by
    have := Int.floor_add_intCast y (q : ℤ); push_cast at this; exact this
  rw [hfl]
  set S := Finset.Ioc N (N + q)
  set c : ℝ := N + (q + 1) / 2
  have hdist : ∀ n ∈ S, |(n : ℝ) - c| ≤ q / 2 := by
    intro n hn
    rw [Finset.mem_Ioc] at hn
    have h1 : (N : ℝ) + 1 ≤ n := by exact_mod_cast (by omega : N + 1 ≤ n)
    have h2 : (n : ℝ) ≤ N + q := by exact_mod_cast hn.2
    rw [abs_le]; constructor <;> simp only [c] <;> linarith

proof_context.conclusion: Sets c = N + (q+1)/2 with N = ⌊y⌋ and shows every n in Ioc N (N+q) has |n-c| ≤ q/2 (the centred index j = n-c).
